name: Cardinal Electronics
old_description: 50+ Years of Electronics Repair in Louisville and Kentuckiana
about:
Founded in 1974, Cardinal Electronics has operated from Fairdale, Kentucky for over five decades, serving the Louisville metropolitan area and surrounding counties including Bullitt, Meade, Hardin, and Spencer. The business began as a local television repair shop and gradually expanded its service lineup to match evolving consumer electronics.

Today the shop specializes in consumer electronics repair, handling television sets, laptop and desktop computers, home stereo systems, and radios. Technicians diagnose and fix issues ranging from fuzzy pictures and power failures to virus infections and hardware damage. In addition to repair services, the company stocks reconditioned televisions, laptops, and desktop computers that have been inspected for resale, offering an affordable alternative to new purchases.

Cardinal Electronics primarily serves residential customers throughout the Kentuckiana region who need quick restoration of their personal devices. Walk-in clients bring equipment to the Mitchell Hill Road facility, while phone consultations provide preliminary estimates. The service area covers both urban Louisville neighborhoods and the more rural communities of the adjacent counties.

The business emphasizes fast turnaround times and backs its repairs with a warranty, aiming to return devices promptly at what it describes as fair and reasonable rates. Its longevity in the market is cited as a sign of consistent service quality, with the owner noting that over 50 years of experience informs every repair job.
